hero.title: We'd love to hear from you
hero.description: Questions, feedback, bug reports or privacy requests. Send us a note and a real person on the Taskify team will get back to you.

channels.title: Product support
channels.description: Stuck on something in the app? Tell us what happened and we'll help you sort it out.
channels.subject: Taskify support

channels.title: Feedback and ideas
channels.description: Missing a feature or have an idea to make Taskify better? We read every suggestion.
channels.subject: Taskify feedback

channels.title: Privacy requests
channels.description: Ask for a copy of your data or permanent erasure. We handle every request within 30 days.

form.title: Send us a message
form.description: Fill in the details below. Submitting opens your email app with everything ready to send.
form.successTitle: Your email app should be open
form.successDescription: Hit send there and we'll reply within a few working days. If nothing opened, email us directly.

items.question: How quickly will I hear back?
items.answer: We usually reply within one to three working days. Privacy requests are always completed within 30 days.

items.question: Can my whole team use Taskify?
items.answer: Yes. Create a team, invite your members under a team leader and share projects with everyone at once.

items.question: How do I delete my account?
items.answer: Open Profile settings in the app and choose Delete account. If you also want your remaining records permanently erased, send us a privacy request.

items.question: Which platforms does Taskify support?
items.answer: Taskify is built for Android and iOS. Store links appear on the home page as soon as they go live.
